Title: Halloween hair in ten minutes: three easy, free hairstyles for girls
Description: Easy Halloween hairstyles for kids, each made from one simple style: a high ponytail for a horse, lion or unicorn tail, two even pigtails for a scarecrow or a rag doll, and a half-up, half-down under a witch's hat. Each takes 4 to 6 minutes, and every step is free on Dad Hair Hero, written for anyone who hasn't done much hair. Free app for iPhone and Android, no ads, no account.
